0022600018.text: The Knicks (2-3, 8th in the East, 4th in the Atlantic and 2 games back) visit the 76ers (4-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) for New York's sixth game of the season, with the Knicks on a two-game win streak and Philadelphia on a one-game streak after going 4-1 over its last five. The Knicks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 before New York won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0. New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Jabari Walker is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision.
